scope.flow: Distributor.addRewards updates pending-reward accounting before the external transferFrom, allowing a malicious token to re-enter claimRewards or other entrypoints during transferFrom
scope.environment: Distributor contract with a malicious or reentrant token used as the reward asset

statements.text: addRewards and claimRewards are external functions that perform transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard

addRewards must not expose a reentrancy window in which claimRewards or other entrypoints can be invoked while pending-reward accounting has already been increased but the external transferFrom has not completed

evidence.text: Distributor.addRewards updates internal pending-reward accounting before performing the external transferFrom call. A malicious token can re-enter during transferFrom and call claimRewards (or other entrypoints) while accounting has already been increased, producing a clear reentrancy window that can be used for griefing and, in some scenarios, monetary extraction.

Attackers can force the code path to re-enter claimRewards during addRewards, demonstrating an exploitable reentrancy window. This enables griefing and may be combined with other weaknesses to steal tokens.
